This exchange of energy is carried out by the difference in hotness between our body and sunlight in the first case and between our body and snow in the later cases. In all above cases, the exchanged amount of energy or energy in transit is heat. Hence, heat is the energy which is transferred on the account of temperature difference between one body and another body. The natural transfer of heat is a non-mechanical process.

It is not necessary for the heat to flow from a body which has more heat energy to a body which has less heat energy. For example; A full bucket of warm water contains more heat energy than a red, hot iron nail. But if we immerse the nail in warm water heat will flow from the nail to the warm water to attain thermal equilibrium.

In the molecular concept, all substances are composed of large number of molecules. These molecules are in random motion except at the absolute zero temperature. Therefore, they possess kinetic energy. “The sum of the kinetic energy of all molecules of a substance is the measure of heat energy contained in that substance”.

Heat is the energy in transit or exchange amount of energy and can be measured by using calorimeter. SI unit of heat is joule (J) but commonly heat is measured in calorie (cal). Such that1 cal = 4.18 J.
Thermal energy is the energy contained in a system but heat is the flow of thermal energy.

9.4 Temperature Temperature is the degree of hotness or coldness of a body which determines the direction of heat flow. When two bodies at different temperatures are brought in thermal contact then the cold body warms up and the hot body cools down. Due to the difference in the thermal state (hotness), heat is lost by hot body which is transferred towards cold body. Hence heat of cold body increases. Thus, the temperature is the thermal state of a body which determines the direction of heat flow between two bodies in thermal contact.
